answer.reason: Several events of Gideon's story happened at Ophrah, and the verses state them plainly.

clauses.english: was where the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon under an oak
clauses.quote: there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah

clauses.english: was where Gideon made an ephod that all Israel went after as a snare
clauses.quote: Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah

clauses.english: was where Abimelech slew his seventy brethren upon one stone
clauses.quote: went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal

doubts: Gideon's altar Jehovahshalom (JDG 6:24) and his burial (JDG 8:32) at Ophrah were left out to keep the line short.
